findings.caveat_en: n=34, single run per cell; shows the label is insufficient, not that one publisher is generally better.
findings.claim_en: Two checkpoints both labelled NVFP4 (or Q4, AWQ, …) are the same thing, so score differences between them measure the model or the fine-tune.
findings.claim_zh: 兩個都標 NVFP4(或 Q4、AWQ…)的 checkpoint 是同一種東西,分數差異反映的是模型或微調。
findings.conditions: 2x RTX PRO 6000 (sm_120), SGLang, 27B dense model at NVFP4 from two publishers (mixed FP8-attention+NVFP4-MLP recipe vs uniform W4A4), temp 1.0, identical exam version

evidence.detail: mixed recipe vs uniform W4A4, same abliterated weights
identical swap on stock weights — pure noise
same model, no-spec decode, recipe is the variable

findings.measured_en: Same brain, same sampling, same engine image, same 34-task agentic exam — swapping ONLY the quantization recipe moved 8 of 34 tasks from fail to pass with 0 moving the other way (McNemar exact p=0.0078). The identical recipe swap on a second set of weights was 6-vs-5 noise (p=1.00): whether the label hides a large effect depends on things the label does not state.
findings.measured_zh: 同一顆大腦、同 sampling、同引擎 image、同一份 34 題 agentic 考卷——只換量化配方就讓 8/34 題翻正、0 題翻負(McNemar 精確 p=0.0078)。同一個配方變更在另一組權重上是 6 比 5 的雜訊(p=1.00):標籤底下藏不藏大效應,取決於標籤沒寫的東西。
findings.repro_en: Before comparing two quantized checkpoints, diff their quantization_config (method, format, per-group bit widths and layer coverage, ignore-list length). If any field differs, you are comparing recipes, not models.
findings.title_en: A shared quant label is not a shared condition
findings.title_zh: 同一個量化標籤不是同一個條件

findings.caveat_en: Flip rates are for temp 1.0 sampling on agentic multi-turn tasks; greedy decoding or single-turn tasks may sit lower.
findings.claim_en: Model A scored 29/34 and model B 23/34 on the same exam, so A is better — significance test says p=0.03.
findings.claim_zh: A 模型同一份考卷拿 29/34、B 拿 23/34,所以 A 比較強——顯著性檢定 p=0.03。
findings.conditions: same weights, engine, sampling (temp 1.0), exam version and machine across reruns; agentic multi-turn coding tasks

evidence.detail: three independent config pairs, n=2..6 each
best sample of one config vs worst of the other
Mann-Whitney exact; min attainable p was 0.004, so power was there
evidence.metric: same comparison with n=6 vs n=5

findings.measured_en: Re-running the IDENTICAL configuration (nothing changed, verified server-side) flipped 14.7-23.5% of tasks per rerun. One config produced {23,25,26,26,27} over five runs; its comparator produced {23,25,27,27,29,29} over six. The original single-run comparison (29 vs 23, paired p=0.03) was the top of one distribution against the bottom of the other; with real samples the difference is p=0.28 — indistinguishable. Across 11 runs, only 12 of 34 tasks passed every time and 3 failed every time: over half the exam behaves as weighted coin flips.
findings.measured_zh: 同一個設定原地重跑(逐項驗過 server 什麼都沒變),每次翻面 14.7–23.5% 的題目。一個設定五次是 {23,25,26,26,27},對照組六次是 {23,25,27,27,29,29}。原本的單次比較(29 對 23、配對 p=0.03)是拿一個分佈的頂端比另一個的底端;補足樣本後 p=0.28——分不出來。合併 11 次跑分,34 題只有 12 題每次都過、3 題每次都不過:超過一半的題目行為像加權擲硬幣。
findings.repro_en: Rerun any agentic benchmark twice with nothing changed and count per-task flips before trusting a between-model gap smaller than that flip count.
findings.source: run-to-run variance study, 11 same-condition reruns over three config pairs
findings.title_en: A single benchmark run is a sample, not a score
findings.title_zh: 單次跑分是一個樣本,不是一個分數

findings.caveat_en: The per-request tax size is fabric- and stack-specific; the direction (bench and agent workloads disagreeing) is the transferable part.
findings.claim_en: Config B streams 31% more tokens per second than config A on a generation benchmark, so it will finish your coding-agent work faster.
findings.claim_zh: B 設定在生成 benchmark 上比 A 快 31%,所以跑 coding agent 也會更快。
findings.conditions: 2x RTX PRO 6000, PCIe Gen4 x8/x8, no NVLink; 27B dense NVFP4; same drafter and sampling both configs; ~950 requests per exam

evidence.detail: elapsed minus completion/decode-rate, median per turn

findings.measured_en: Tensor-parallel over two GPUs measured 1.31x FASTER on a single-stream generation bench (157.6 -> 206.8 tok/s, 1024-token generations, hot cache) and 1.19x SLOWER on the full agentic exam (23.3 -> 27.7 min of API time). Agent work is ~a thousand short requests; the prefix cache absorbs the prompt (the single-GPU config's per-turn non-decode residual measures ~zero), so what decides the race is per-request fixed latency — and the two-GPU config pays ~+0.26s per request in cross-card synchronization. A single-stream bench cannot see a per-request tax because it is a single request.
findings.measured_zh: 雙卡 tensor-parallel 在單流生成 bench 快 1.31×(157.6→206.8 tok/s,1024 token 生成、熱快取),但整份 agentic 考卷慢 1.19×(API 時間 23.3→27.7 分鐘)。agent 工作是約一千個短請求;prefix cache 吸收了 prompt(單卡設定的每回合非-decode 殘差量到約等於零),勝負在每請求固定延遲——雙卡設定每個請求多付約 0.26 秒的跨卡同步。單流 bench 看不到每請求稅,因為它只有一個請求。
findings.repro_en: Measure end-to-end wall on a many-short-requests workload, not tokens/second on one long generation; the two can rank configs in opposite orders.
findings.source: TP=1 vs TP=2 study: 11 scored exam runs + per-turn timing decomposition
findings.title_en: Decode tok/s does not predict agent speed
findings.title_zh: decode tok/s 不能預測 agent 的實際速度

findings.caveat_en: One model family, one engine, one card; the crossover point moves with context length, KV dtype and memory split — the pool arithmetic is the transferable part, not the number 16.
findings.claim_en: This drafter gives 2.4x faster decoding, so enable it on the serving endpoint.
findings.claim_zh: 這個 drafter 讓 decode 快 2.4×,所以伺服端點應該開著它。
findings.conditions: single RTX PRO 6000, SGLang, 27B dense NVFP4 + 2B drafter, 30k-token context per stream, fp8 KV, rotated prefixes (no shared-prefix cache inflation)

evidence.detail: KV pool thrash, not accept decay

evidence.metric: KV pool cost of the drafter

findings.measured_en: The same drafter that measured 2.41x at 1 concurrent stream measured 0.17x — a 6x NET LOSS — at 16 streams, on the same server and weights. The mechanism is not the accept-rate decay the literature describes: the draft model consumes 27% of the KV-cache pool (1,034,466 -> 753,734 tokens), so at ~60-80% pool occupancy the prefix cache starts thrashing. The tell: at 16 streams the drafter config's cache-hot TTFT (30.7s) equalled its cache-cold TTFT (33.3s) — the cache had stopped working — while the no-drafter config still showed 4.4s hot vs 32.9s cold.
findings.measured_zh: 同一個 drafter,1 條併發量到 2.41×,16 條併發量到 0.17×——淨賠 6 倍,同一台 server 同一組權重。機制不是文獻講的 accept rate 衰減:draft 模型吃掉 27% 的 KV 池(1,034,466→753,734 tokens),工作集到池的約 60–80% 時 prefix cache 開始輾轉替換。證據:16 條併發時 drafter 設定的熱 TTFT(30.7s)跟冷 TTFT(33.3s)一樣——快取失效——而無 drafter 設定仍是熱 4.4s 對冷 32.9s。
findings.repro_en: Read the server's reported KV-pool size with the drafter on and off; divide your total concurrent context by it. When the working set nears the pool, the drafter's speedup is gone regardless of its accept rate.
findings.source: concurrency curve study: 5 levels x {drafter on, off} x {cold, hot}, per-level cache flush
findings.title_en: A speculative-decoding speedup measured at batch 1 can invert under load
findings.title_zh: bs=1 量到的 spec-decode 加速,上了併發可能整個反轉

findings.caveat_en: Absolute TTFTs are hardware-specific; the cold/hot spread and its growth with depth are the transferable part.
findings.claim_en: The spec sheet quotes prefill and generation tok/s (measured at a few hundred tokens), which tells you how the model will feel to use.
findings.claim_zh: 規格表引 prefill 與生成 tok/s(幾百 token 量的),這告訴你實際用起來的體感。
findings.conditions: RTX PRO 6000, SGLang, 27B dense NVFP4, measured at 30k and 120k context depths, cold = flushed prefix cache

evidence.detail: a KV-quant flag on this engine requires disabling prefix cache
evidence.value: every request becomes the cold path

findings.measured_en: Time-to-first-token at 120k tokens of real context measured 28.6s cold vs 0.7s cache-hot on the same server — a 40x spread invisible to any single throughput number. At 30k context: 3.6s cold vs 0.18s hot. Which of those a user gets is a cache-policy and serving-config property, not a model property; one KV-quantization option on this engine required disabling the prefix cache entirely, silently converting every request to the 40x-worse cold path. Our own public speed board's pp512/tg128 columns are 512-token-prefill figures — the depth rows exist so that shape never stands alone.
findings.measured_zh: 同一台 server,120k token 真實 context 的首字延遲:冷 28.6 秒、快取命中 0.7 秒——40 倍的差距,任何單一吞吐數字都看不見。30k context:冷 3.6 秒、熱 0.18 秒。使用者拿到哪一種,取決於快取政策與 serving 設定,不是模型本身;這個引擎的某個 KV 量化選項要求整個關掉 prefix cache,等於把每個請求都靜默轉成慢 40 倍的冷路徑。我們自己公開 speed 板的 pp512/tg128 就是 512-token prefill 的數字——depth rows 的存在就是讓那種形狀永遠不單獨出現。
findings.repro_en: Ask any throughput claim two questions: at what context depth, and cold or cache-hot? If the answer is a few hundred tokens, the number describes a benchmark, not your workload.
findings.source: TTFT depth study + serving configuration notes
findings.title_en: Short-context throughput hides what depth does to latency
findings.title_zh: 短 context 吞吐數字藏住了深度對延遲做的事
